title: Elie Saab perfume: Le Parfum, Intense, Elixir, Nuit Noor and the Essences compared
body:
Elie Saab perfume is built around white flowers, honey and amber, from the bright Le Parfum to the darker Nuit Noor. Here is every Elie Saab fragrance we stock, what is in each one, and which to choose, for yourself or as a gift.

Elie Saab Le Parfum

Elie Saab Le Parfum Eau de Parfum (50ml) is where to start: orange blossom, then two kinds of jasmine, over cedarwood, patchouli, honey and rose. Bright white flowers with a soft, woody sweetness, it suits daytime and the office.

Le Parfum Intense and Le Parfum Bridal

Le Parfum Eau de Parfum Intense (90ml) is richer and warmer: orange blossom, then ylang-ylang and rose, over honey, amber and patchouli. Le Parfum Bridal (90ml) is creamier: orange blossom, neroli and mandarin orange, then gardenia, ylang-ylang and vanilla, over musk, amber and benzoin.

Elie Saab Elixir

Elie Saab Elixir Eau de Parfum (50ml) pairs mandarin and neroli with rose and powdery iris, over amber, vanilla, musk and woods. Polished by day, warmer as the vanilla and amber come through.

Elie Saab Nuit Noor

Elie Saab Nuit Noor Eau de Parfum (90ml) is the evening scent of the range: black pepper and spices, then rose, jasmine and incense, over patchouli, amber, musk and woods.

Elie Saab gift sets

  • Le Parfum Lumière Gift Set: a 90ml eau de parfum, a 10ml travel spray and a 75ml body lotion. Mandarin orange, orange blossom and ylang-ylang, then jasmine and tuberose, over patchouli, amber and musk.
  • Le Parfum Gift Set: a 90ml Le Parfum eau de parfum with a 75ml body lotion and a 75ml shower gel.

The Girl of Now Lovely gift set is sold out at the moment. More boxed ideas are in our perfume gift sets guide.

La Collection des Essences: No. 1 Rose and No. 4 Oud

These two are unisex and built around a single key note. No. 1 Rose (100ml) puts rose at the centre, with floral accords over amber, woods and musk. No. 4 Oud (100ml) is built around oud, with woody accords and spices over amber, resins and musk. For more oud scents, see our oud perfume guide.

Which Elie Saab perfume should you choose?

  • Bright white flowers for every day: Le Parfum.
  • Richer, with honey and amber: Le Parfum Intense.
  • Creamy, with gardenia and vanilla: Le Parfum Bridal.
  • Rose and iris: Elixir.
  • Dark and spicy, for evenings: Nuit Noor.
  • Unisex: No. 1 Rose or No. 4 Oud.
  • A gift: the Le Parfum Lumière or Le Parfum gift set.
